title: GitHub Audit | Activity & Freshness
description: Partition-pruned and deduplicated audit activity plotted by normalization day, plus source-to-normalization delay.

options.content:
**Daily UTC trends.** All panels follow the global time picker; default: **90 days**. Auto-refresh is off to limit Athena scans. Use the dashboard links above to switch sections while preserving the time range.

**No data is not zero usage.** Only recorded dates are shown; lines may connect sparse observations. Missing source values are not replaced with zero.

Charts use **normalization time**, not original GitHub event time, to align with bronze partition pruning. Events are deduplicated by document ID within the selected range. Replays can move events to a newer normalization day. Delay includes source delivery, backlog, and replays. Actor names are used only for aggregate distinct counts; names, IPs, and raw payloads are not displayed. Restrict datasource access appropriately.

panels.title: Audit logs | Ingested activity & data freshness
Ingested audit events & distinct actors
panels.description: Deduplicated by document_id within the selected normalization-time window. Actor names are used only for aggregate distinct counts and never displayed. Replays can move the selected occurrence to a newer normalization day.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT normalized_at, actor,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY document_id
      ORDER BY normalized_at DESC, source_object_key DESC, source_record_index DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_audit_logs_bronze_dev.bronze_events
  WHERE record_family = 'audit'
    AND year BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy')
    AND concat(year, '-', month, '-', day, ' ', hour)
      BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd HH') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd HH')
    AND $__timeFilter(normalized_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', normalized_at) AS time,
  count(*) AS audit_events, count(DISTINCT actor) AS distinct_actors
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Top 10 ingested audit categories
panels.description: Top categories by total deduplicated audit events in the selected normalization-time range, plotted daily. Top categories can change when the time range changes; all actors are aggregated.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT normalized_at, coalesce(action_category, 'Uncategorized') AS category,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY document_id
      ORDER BY normalized_at DESC, source_object_key DESC, source_record_index DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_audit_logs_bronze_dev.bronze_events
  WHERE record_family = 'audit'
    AND year BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy')
    AND concat(year, '-', month, '-', day, ' ', hour)
      BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd HH') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd HH')
    AND $__timeFilter(normalized_at)
), events AS (
  SELECT normalized_at, category FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
), top_categories AS (
  SELECT category FROM events GROUP BY category ORDER BY count(*) DESC, category LIMIT 10
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', normalized_at) AS time, category, count(*) AS events
FROM events
WHERE category IN (SELECT category FROM top_categories)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2

panels.title: Ingested audit events by operation type
panels.description: Source operation_type labels, including an explicit Unspecified bucket for missing labels. Deduplicated by document_id and grouped by normalization day, not original event day.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT normalized_at, operation_type,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY document_id
      ORDER BY normalized_at DESC, source_object_key DESC, source_record_index DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_audit_logs_bronze_dev.bronze_events
  WHERE record_family = 'audit'
    AND year BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy')
    AND concat(year, '-', month, '-', day, ' ', hour)
      BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd HH') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd HH')
    AND $__timeFilter(normalized_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', normalized_at) AS time,
  coalesce(operation_type, 'Unspecified') AS operation, count(*) AS events
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2

panels.title: Audit event-to-normalization delay | median & p95
panels.description: Minutes from GitHub event_timestamp to normalization, grouped by normalization day after document_id deduplication. Includes source delivery delays, backlog, and replays; not just processing latency. Missing/negative delays are excluded.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT normalized_at, event_timestamp,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY document_id
      ORDER BY normalized_at DESC, source_object_key DESC, source_record_index DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_audit_logs_bronze_dev.bronze_events
  WHERE record_family = 'audit'
    AND year BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy')
    AND concat(year, '-', month, '-', day, ' ', hour)
      BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd HH') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd HH')
    AND $__timeFilter(normalized_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', normalized_at) AS time,
  approx_percentile(date_diff('second', event_timestamp, normalized_at) / 60.0, 0.5) AS median_minutes,
  approx_percentile(date_diff('second', event_timestamp, normalized_at) / 60.0, 0.95) AS p95_minutes
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND event_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND normalized_at >= event_timestamp
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC
